description: Create (no id) or update (id) one fitness test case of an agent. Required on create: agent_id, name, kanal, schritte. List of steps. Channel whatsapp/webchat/server_job: [{nachricht: "…"}] (a plain string is read as {nachricht}). Channel mcp: [{werkzeug: "tool_name", argumente: {…}}]. Checks, all optional: werkzeuge_pflicht[], werkzeuge_verboten[], antwort_enthaelt[], antwort_enthaelt_nicht[], antwort_regex, max_zeichen, max_sekunden, ki_kriterium (an AI judge decides ok/not ok). Unknown keys are rejected. Side effects of tools with external effect: {standard: "simulieren"|"echt" (default simulieren — nothing is executed, the call is logged), werkzeuge: {tool: "simulieren"|"umleiten"|"echt"}, umleiten_an: test mailbox for mail-like tools in mode umleiten, aufraeumen: true deletes what an "echt" call created}. Read-only tools always run for real. als_user_id = in whose name the case runs (whatsapp default: the tenant's fitness test user). quelle = incident/ticket the case comes from. Admins, planners and agents with the right only.

als_user_id.description: User the case runs as (must be a member of this tenant)

beschreibung.description: Free-text description of what the test case checks

erwartungen.description: Checks, all optional: werkzeuge_pflicht[], werkzeuge_verboten[], antwort_enthaelt[], antwort_enthaelt_nicht[], antwort_regex, max_zeichen, max_sekunden, ki_kriterium (an AI judge decides ok/not ok). Unknown keys are rejected.

id.description: Existing case to update; omit to create

kanal.description: Channel the test case runs on; required on create

nebenwirkungen.description: Side effects of tools with external effect: {standard: "simulieren"|"echt" (default simulieren — nothing is executed, the call is logged), werkzeuge: {tool: "simulieren"|"umleiten"|"echt"}, umleiten_an: test mailbox for mail-like tools in mode umleiten, aufraeumen: true deletes what an "echt" call created}. Read-only tools always run for real.

quelle.description: Incident or ticket the case comes from

schritte.description: List of steps. Channel whatsapp/webchat/server_job: [{nachricht: "…"}] (a plain string is read as {nachricht}). Channel mcp: [{werkzeug: "tool_name", argumente: {…}}].
